reproducible_execution_dispatch_failure.discrepancy: Controller runner process PID 27092 entered research_preparation despite Turn 343 routing fixes, causing checkpoint task_type/operation_id mismatch and dispatch of preparation commands instead of qualified execution.

root_cause_diagnosis.mechanism: PID 27092 has run continuously since 08:51:15. PowerShell does not re-parse in-memory script functions during a running loop. Consequently, PID 27092 executed the 08:51:15 in-memory versions of Resolve-ControllerTaskType and Get-ControllerOperation, which lacked evaluate_mode1_package148_state_transfer_r3 and threw UNQUALIFIED_OR_RETIRED_OPERATION, defaulting to RESEARCH_PREPARATION. In a fresh process with disk sources, Resolve-ControllerTaskType evaluates to QUALIFIED_EXECUTION deterministically.
root_cause_diagnosis.secondary_defect: Invoke-ControllerTurn.ps1 line 198 (Stage Complete) has an asymmetric check: it checks '$operation.path -cne $state.scientific_operation' without the '-and $operation.id -cne $state.scientific_operation' allowance present on line 119 (Stage Scientific). This would cause closeout to reject with 'Closeout operation mismatch' even if Stage Scientific succeeded.

direct_developer_corrections_required: 1. Terminate stale PowerShell controller runner process PID 27092.

2. Patch Invoke-ControllerTurn.ps1 line 198 to match line 119: if($operation.id -cne $record.operation_id -or ($operation.path -cne $state.scientific_operation -and $operation.id -cne $state.scientific_operation)){throw 'Closeout operation mismatch'}.
3. Restart Antigravity-Autonomous-Loop.ps1 freshly so all disk sources are loaded into process memory.
